features.C8_cultural_adaptation_method: N/A (critique of ETHICS benchmark)

References MFQ-2 as better starting point.

papers.scoring_notes: 31-page paper. NORMAD-ETI has 2,600 situational descriptions from 75 countries. Social etiquette domain. 3 levels of cultural specificity. Best LLM <82% vs humans >95%. Models show English-centric bias. Performance drops to <60% with abstract contexts.

features.C8_cultural_adaptation_method: ground-up construction from canonical Islamic sources (Quran); verse-level retrieval corpus
features.G3_novelty: First generative Islamic QA benchmark measuring hallucination and abstention; agentic RAG framework with Quran-level verse retrieval; 25K SFT pairs + 5K preference samples

papers.scoring_notes: 20-page paper. ISLAMICFAITHQA has 3,810 bilingual items with atomic single-gold answers. Agentic RAG with structured tool calls. Best performance: Fanar-2-27B + Agentic RAG at 57.30 accuracy. Most off-the-shelf LLMs below 30% accuracy.
